## Upscaler API

Upscaler is an image upscaling model by Venice, available on the Venice API as `upscaler`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Upscaler is Venice's image upscaling model, enlarging an image 2x to 4x, up to 4096×4096 pixels. An optional creativity setting lets it add fine detail and texture as it scales.

### Upscaler API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `upscaler` | Upscale | Private | $0.02 / 2x |

### Upscaler specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Venice |
| Released | Apr 12, 2025 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |

### How to use the Upscaler API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/upscale` with `"model": "upscaler"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/upscale \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "upscaler",
    "image": "<base64-encoded image>",
    "scale": 2
  }' --output result.png
```
